customer_name.description: Customer name, or 'Unknown' if not given

phone.description: Customer phone in E.164 format (e.g. +919000000003), or empty string if not given

order_id.description: Order ID like UT1003, or empty string if not relevant

priority.description: high if angry, refund > Rs 5,000, damaged item or payment problem

summary.description: 2-3 sentence summary of the problem for the human agent

suggested_action.description: One concrete next step for the human agent
